repository_baseline.interpretation: The exact supplied checkout tip is the only available current-main proxy; no claim is made that live hosted main was verified.

governing_question: Can the existing Architectural Boundary Research methodology produce valid, bounded, reproducible results on materially different external public repositories without relying on hidden Continufy-specific assumptions?

cohort_selection.minimum_size_rationale: Three is the issue minimum and avoids widening an execution already subject to a repository-owned instrument readiness gate.
eligibility_criteria: public Git repository not controlled by joselunasrt8-creator
locally available immutable Git object and origin identity
repository material sufficient to attempt a repository-architecture audit if preflight permits
material heterogeneity in architecture or purpose across the cohort
selection not based on an expected favorable ABR result
exclusions: the reported historical phpenv/phpenv single-target pilot, to avoid treating prior evidence as a new prospective outcome
targets lacking a locally reproducible immutable commit at freeze time

targets.purpose_architecture: Node.js version manager implemented primarily as a sourced POSIX-shell function
Python version manager using executable shims, shell integration, and a plugin layout
PHP source-build automation with executable build logic and version-definition recipes

instrument.name: Architectural Investigation Instrument
instrument.selection_rationale: This is the existing repository instrument most directly shaped for cross-repository boundary investigations. No substitute or new stage is introduced.
instrument.known_pre_execution_fact: The readiness record says the candidate is not frozen, not implementation-ready, and not legitimately bindable; this fact is an instrument-level prerequisite, not a target outcome.

required_source_classes: release or version metadata when present
binding_rules: Use only the frozen target commit; branch names are contextual.
Verify target origin, commit object, and default-branch observation before instrument binding.
Apply the selected instrument readiness-and-binding rules before substantive target inspection.
Do not infer audit authorization, frozen status, calibration, or normative dependencies.
Do not silently substitute a target, instrument version, source class, or commit.
stopping_rules: Stop before substantive target inspection when authoritative instrument binding fails.
Stop before inspection when target identity cannot reproduce.
Do not repair target-specific or instrument-specific blockers during this cohort.
Once stopped, preserve all later stages and required source classes as NOT_REACHED rather than absent findings.

missing_data_semantics.NOT_REACHED: The stopping rule prevented collection; not evidence of nonexistence.
missing_data_semantics.MISSING_REQUIRED: A required source class was sought after valid entry and was absent.
missing_data_semantics.INACCESSIBLE: The source was identified but could not be read.
missing_data_semantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: The frozen protocol does not require the class for that target.
missing_data_semantics.rule: Blocked execution is not a negative structural finding.

adjudication_rules: Mechanical checks may verify identities, controlled values, local references, and equality only.
Manual judgments must record question, evidence, decision, rationale, uncertainty, reasonable disagreement, and effect.
No vocabulary mapping may be forced; ambiguous or Continufy-specific fit is recorded rather than repaired.
Exactly one per-target terminal value and one cohort value are required.

target_terminal_definitions.VALID_DETERMINATE_RESULT: Valid execution completed with a determinate bounded result.
target_terminal_definitions.VALID_INDETERMINATE_RESULT: Valid execution completed but evidence supports only indeterminacy.
target_terminal_definitions.PREEXECUTION_STOP: A frozen non-authority entry rule stopped execution before substantive inspection.
target_terminal_definitions.BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITATIVE_BINDING: Instrument, authorization, normative dependency, or source-authority binding failed before valid execution.
target_terminal_definitions.BLOCKED_BY_REQUIRED_MEASUREMENTS: Valid entry occurred but frozen required measurements could not be obtained.
target_terminal_definitions.METHODOLOGY_FAILURE: The existing methodology cannot express or execute the frozen task without semantic invention.
target_terminal_definitions.EXECUTION_INVALID: Execution violated a frozen identity, procedure, evidence-chain, or integrity rule.

cohort_decision_rule.if: any target is EXECUTION_INVALID or prospective separation is violated
all entered executions expose methodology failure or forced semantic invention
all targets are blocked or stopped before valid substantive execution
valid executions exist but evidence cannot distinguish partial transfer from non-transfer
all targets validly execute, bind authoritatively, reproduce where tested, and show no material forced fit
at least one target validly executes and transfers but full-cohort support rule is unmet

rerun_procedure: Choose the lexicographically first target for which the frozen protocol permits a rerun.
Repeat identity and instrument-binding checks from the same pinned inputs in a clean record.
Compare source identity, reached stages, terminal classification, machine-readable fields, and manual judgments.
non_claims: External target is not external adoption.
Successful execution is not a useful result.
Blocked execution is not a negative structural finding.
Vocabulary fit is not structural truth.
Cross-repository generalization is not universal validity.
This study does not establish usefulness, economic value, or external user value.
